## Problem and change / 问题与修改

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation / 验证

List commands actually run, their results and any checks not run with reasons.
For documentation, identify the links/examples checked. For experiments, distinguish
saved-evidence replay, new inference and training; include runtime and input identity.

## Scope and evidence / 范围与证据

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation matches the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, or missing checks are explained above.
- [ ] Existing frozen records and negative results are preserved; new results use a new directory.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or unlicensed third-party assets are included.

Describe compatibility changes, new dependencies and remaining limitations, if any.
